cards.title: Compute, losses, limits
cards.sub: $72.4B of the $80.7B net loss never left the building

blocks.title: What the filing warns about
items: Growth may not last — the surge reflects early adoption, per the filing
Compute is booked 12–18 months early; the cost lands before revenue does
$72.4B of the loss is fair-value moves on converts, derivatives, SAFE
Top five customers are ~25% of revenue; compute leans on three clouds

takeaways: Convert losses fade at IPO — RSU charges start right after
What investors buy is not today’s profit but the build-out
The bet is one vertical chain, priced at a trillion dollars
